concerns: Label-using feature selection leakage: screen() fits SelectKBest(f_classif) on all X and y in claimed_eval() before cross-validation in evaluate(), so scored rows influence which features are selected. This is expressible with move_into_fold for a selector.
independent_review.reason: Intended use is stated as independent random-row prediction with measurements available before inspection and no chronological or grouped claim, so no temporal or group split information is missing. The only identified evaluation flaw—global supervised feature selection before folding—can be investigated within the frozen contract using move_into_fold(step, call) for the selector.

factors.flaw: Label-using feature selection before CV: screen uses y on all rows to choose k, then CV scores rows already seen during selection.
